text_block_list.text: Hmm... I wonder what's going on...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Um... We're finally on a temple date, but
my
engines are totally cold.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Am I sick or something?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
P-please, Nyankichi! I told you I can't
right now...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Huh? That voice...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Meooow!
text_block_list.name: Cat

text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Найс Нэйчер—with a cat!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
What are you doing here? Are you two
playing
hide-and-seek?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: N-no... I hope I'm not being a bother...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I mean, the love fortunes here are so
famous!
They're basically a must-do for
couples... That's
why you're here, right?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Love fortunes?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
That sounds like fun! ♪ Let's go get one,
Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Not that I need a fortune to know we're
perfect
for each other! ☆ But still... it
sounds exciting!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
As per Маяно Топ Ган's wish, we go
and grab a
love fortune.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: What does it say? Show me, show me!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
...Whoa! "Your love is on a direct flight
to
success!" Yay! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
My! Even the gods have recognized you
as the
best couple ever! How lovely!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Ehehe. The best couple ever...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thanks, Trainer! You too, Nature!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Think nothing of it. I had fun too.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Still, you're as naive as—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Ahem. I mean, as cute as always.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Huh? Really? Ehehe!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: You get along fine?! That's it?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
F-fine... fine... Get along fine... What
does that
even mean?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
D-don't stress over it! Getting along fine
takes
work too! It means your
relationship is stable!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah... You're right! It's just a silly
fortune!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Yep, something like that would never
bother a
grown-up like me!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
My! Of course! You are the cream of the

grown-up crop, Mayano!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Uh-huh. I already knew that.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: But still...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Oh my... I guess that wasn't good
enough for you.
I should've known.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган is right back to her
normal self
thanks to the fortune.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With the fortune being what it was,
Mayano Top
Gun is unable to return to
her normal self...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
